appraisal_events.evidence: After the procession of liveried footmen 'pareils aux figurants dont le cortège... prépare, et par là même diminue l'apparition finale de la reine,' Mme Swann enters 'furtivement en petit paletot de loutre, sa voilette baissée sur un nez rougi par le froid,' and 'ne tenait pas les promesses prodiguées dans l'attente à mon imagination.'
appraisal_events.explanation: The elaborate ceremonial buildup of footmen explicitly likened to a queen's diminished royal entrance sets up Mme Swann's actual, hurried, unglamorous arrival as a clear anticlimax, deflating the majestic image the narrator's anticipation had built.

appraisal_events.evidence: Swann offers to show the narrator the lingerie room and promises to make Gilberte take him there each time she goes, 'supprima brusquement pour moi une de ces affreuses distances intérieures'; the narrator states 'j'éprouvai pour lui une tendresse que je crus plus profonde que ma tendresse pour Gilberte,' since as 'maître de sa fille,' Swann gives the narrator an indirect hold over her that he lacks directly, 'elle, elle se refusait parfois.'
appraisal_events.explanation: Swann's generous, paternal exercise of authority over Gilberte on the narrator's behalf earns him an avowed, striking surge of the narrator's tenderness explicitly said to exceed his feeling for Gilberte herself, a clear local elevation grounded in Swann's benevolent leverage.

status_effects.explanation: The narrator's own private disappointment at her anticlimactic, unglamorous entrance deflates the queenly image his anticipation had constructed.
By exercising his paternal authority in the narrator's favor, Swann earns a depth of tenderness from the narrator explicitly described as surpassing his feeling for Gilberte, a clear local elevation.
Her own occasional refusals are rendered moot by her father's authority, which the narrator notes gives him more effective 'empire' over her indirectly through Swann than he has directly.

ambiguities: The passage also offers a counter-note (Odette's peignoir on days spent at home is called more elegant than any dress), but the elaborately staged anticlimactic entrance is the more developed and structurally dominant movement.
